name: Joe's Concrete
audience: Homeowners, GCs, and light commercial across Santa Clara County
description: Structural, commercial and residential concrete: flatwork, driveways, stamped and coloured surfaces, retaining walls, equipment pads (including generator pads in Palo Alto) and foundation work. Verified licence badge on Yelp; veterans discount on residential work.
serviceCopy: Repair, grinding and sealing of what exists.
insight: Sunday hours — almost unheard of in concrete, and totally invisible online.
usps: 40+ years of Bay Area mix-design knowledge in marine/fog climates
differentiators: Publishes pour details and cure specs; competitors publish only photos

reputation.note: 44 reviews aggregate across platforms on related listings; long repeat-contractor relationships implied by GC workflow.

afford: Stamped driveways $8K–$25K; structural/commercial pads scale fast
Yelp Guaranteed eligibility indicates account spend
risk: Needs an SEO-consistent NAP record first
